question: How many points advantage must a freestyle wrestler must have against his/ her opponent for the bout to be declared over?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 10.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **In freestyle wrestling, if one wrestler has a 10-point advantage over their opponent, the bout is declared over and the wrestler with the advantage wins by technical superiority.**
 
• This rule is in place to prevent a wrestler from being excessively beaten or injured in a match.

**Wrestling: **__

__
 
• Wrestling is a hand-to-hand combat system.
 
• It is a set of combat sports involving grappling-type techniques such as clinch fighting, throws and takedowns, joint locks, pins, and other grappling holds.
 
• Wrestling techniques have been incorporated into martial arts, combat sports, and military systems.

​Wrestling duration:__

__
 
• A typical freestyle wrestling bout, much like Greco-Roman, is divided into two periods of three minutes each with a 30-second break in between.
 
• For official Under-15, cadets, and veteran competitions, the periods are curtailed to two minutes each.
 
• Two competing wrestlers face each other on a mat, nine-meter in diameter, with the primary objective of pinning the opponent’s shoulders to the mat for a short duration of time, which hands the wrestler an instant victory by ‘fall’.
 
• 
 
Thus, two periods of three minutes is correct with reference to a wrestling match.__

 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] __Additional Information:__

 
Wrestling in the Olympics:

 
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) was formed, and the first Games were planned for 1896 in Athens, the capital of Greece.
 
• In Athens, 280 participants from 13 nations competed in 43 events, covering track-and-field, swimming, gymnastics, cycling, wrestling, weightlifting, fencing, shooting, and tennis.
 
• Since the Olympic Games began in Athens in 1896, wrestling (in the form of Greco-Roman wrestling) became a focus of the Games, with the exception of the 1900 Summer Olympics when wrestling did not appear on the program.
 
• Freestyle wrestling and weight classes both made their first appearance in 1904.
